fact: Kenyans.co.ke reports from Digital Health Agency tender documents that the DHA floated tenders for an AI-driven digital health platform for reproductive, maternal, newborn, child and adolescent health and an AI-managed national blood bank management system, within the Taifa Care platform.
President Ruto said Kenya Revenue Authority's Customs Department piloted AI-powered risk engines, followed by its highest-ever monthly customs revenue of KSh 85 billion.
President Ruto said Kenya is among the earliest Sub-Saharan countries to have integrated AI-powered risk engines into tax compliance at KRA.

Health CS Aden Duale told senators that fraud detection at the Social Health Authority is enabled by an artificial intelligence-driven claims management system that blocks suspicious billing before payment.

Duale said the digital gatekeeper had flagged, rejected and left unpaid Sh12.7 billion of claims by late February 2026, with 1,188 fraudulent files sent to the DCI, 26 suspects charged and 248 facilities under probe.
The Health Committee's report tabled in Parliament says the Social Health Authority's AI-driven claims processing system is in use and rejects some legitimate hospital claims as fraudulent.
Health CS Aden Duale said investigations had uncovered irregular payments of Sh10.6 billion, credited to new safeguards embedded in the SHA system.

Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale told the Senate that the Social Health Authority has deployed AI and machine learning tools in its Claims Adjudication Platform, which detect abnormal claim patterns, inflated billing and duplicate submissions in real time.
Health Cabinet Secretary Duale said the ministry's AI-powered fraud detection system under TaifaCare monitors every transaction in real time and blocks fraudulent claims before disbursement.
Business Daily reports the Kenya Revenue Authority plans AI screening of incoming shipments and says a week of trial use produced 'some serious interceptions'.
Tuko reports President Ruto said the government uses AI to give algorithms on each parent's financial status for the means-testing instrument that distributes education funding.
Tuko reports President Ruto said Kenya uses AI for education-funding means testing, for distributing fertiliser to farmers and for identifying universal health coverage beneficiaries.
The Kenya Revenue Authority has already started piloting artificial intelligence, machine learning and data analytics to simplify tax operations and catch dishonest traders, the outlet reports.
